assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia, accompanied by a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
The diagnoses are I47.1 and G45.9.
The purpose of the order is to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control therapy.
The service is medically necessary to address the documented recurrent palpitations, lightheadedness, and transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
